note: Derived, vendored copy of the K-001 recall contract obligations CIC binds to as a consumer. The Forge artifact is canonical and wins on disagreement; this local copy lets CIC resolve recall THROUGH the socket contract without a filesystem reach-around into OpenBrain. server/recallSocket.js constants are checked against this file.
invariants: Every recall answer CIC renders exposes source (provenance) and freshness.
CIC resolves recall ONLY through the declared entrypoint. Reading OpenBrain's files or database directly is a reach-around and must be rejected, never rendered.
